title: 日本ダービーの後に・悔

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having let first place slip through her fingers at the Japanese Derby, Narita Brian grits her teeth, swallows her disappointment, and vows to get even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Hishi Amazon has just won her second tiara on the Tiara tour. The two of them decide to settle their rivalry at the Arima Kinen once both Classic Triple Crown series are finished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The challenge spikes Narita Brian's fighting spirit. Before that match, however, we have the Kikuka Sho—the final race of the Classic Triple Crown!
